content: If you are a resident of the United States and require assistance, you can contact the Poison Control Center at 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current medical condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your healthcare provider. Missed Dose Instructions: If you forget to take a dose, administer it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to compensate for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from direct light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. For the liquid form of this medication, discard any unused portion after 7 days. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. Important Information: The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this medication and your individual health needs. Side Effects: Common side effects may include headache, nausea, or stomach/abdominal pain. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they have determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you experience any concerning symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. Precautions: Before taking nitazoxanide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. The liquid form of this medication contains sugar, so caution is advised if you have diabetes. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose Instructions: In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call the Poison Control Center at 1-800-222-1222. Additional Notes: This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your healthcare provider. Always follow your healthcare provider’s instructions and seek their advice for any questions or concerns regarding this medication.
